answer: One concrete sybil brake is delayed-release work credit with a lineage cut. A new identity's emissions sit in a velvet escrow and unlock only after M epochs of unique attested work. Every attestation carries a cedar tag: the endorser's first-establishment root plus a short co-signer path. At unlock the applicant publishes a cipher H(key, sorted cedar roots, epoch). If many applicants share near-identical root sets, a min-cut flags the farm cluster and the escrow is burned, with a detector bounty from the residual. Sparse honest graphs unlock; cloned farms fail the cut or the delay.
